title.narrative: Improving organic coffee production and marketing in buffer communities of the Opalaca Nature Reserve

description.narrative: Independent small-scale coffee farmers in the Lempira and Intibuca departments of Honduras struggle to earn enough from coffee sales to cover investments needed to produce in successive seasons. Their income is increasingly limited by unpredictable climatic conditions and fluctuating world markets. The IAF supports community-led solutions to expand economic opportunities that provide productive alternatives to irregular migration. Our grantee Cooperativa Agropecuaria Nuevo Edn Limitada (COARENE) helps small-scale coffee farmers adopt organic practices and achieve certification through training and technical and financial assistance. Finally the organization processes and markets their products to buyers that pay premium prices for high quality coffee. COARENE's activities also promote protection of the nearby Opalaca Biological Reserve whose forests capture store and filter water for many downstream communities and provide shade to stabilize microclimate conditions like temperature.This grant is part of the IAF's efforts to address the root causes of irregular migration in Central America.
